name: core.openwop.workflows.destination-sync
description: CDP → peer-OpenWOP-host onward-sync (ADR 0289/RFC 0128), migrated from the deprecated builtin (ADR 0472 P4). chainId keeps the original id; peerIngestUrl is a declared parameter: prepare-onward refuses a URL that is not the sync's configured one (ADR 1024 D2.5), and the http node config template reads the same run variable.

chains.label: Sync CDP records to a peer host
chains.description: Prepare the onward envelope and POST a CDP record batch to a peer OpenWOP host (purpose-labelled).

syncId.description: The 'openwop-host' destination sync to forward (destinationKind='openwop-host', peerIngestUrl set).

records.description: The CDP record batch to CDC-filter, purpose-label, and forward.

peerIngestUrl.description: The sync's configured peer ingest URL. The run refuses (destination_mismatch) unless it equals the sync's stored peerIngestUrl.
